reference: Independent blind corpus written from SPEC-variationtimeimpact.md rev 2026-10-17.4 (model 2026-10-09.vt-3) with hand-derived checks, a standard-library reference implementation and a second independent route; method cross-checked against AACE RP 52R-06 / 29R-03, the SCL Delay and Disruption Protocol (2nd ed. 2017) and the PMI Practice Standard for Scheduling.
reference_citations: AACE International Recommended Practice No. 52R-06, Prospective Time Impact Analysis - As Applied in Construction (2017 revision)
AACE International Recommended Practice No. 29R-03, Forensic Schedule Analysis (2011)
Society of Construction Law, Delay and Disruption Protocol, 2nd edition, February 2017 (Core Principles 4 and 8, Part B paras 4-11, Appendix A)
Project Management Institute, Practice Standard for Scheduling, 3rd edition (2019), CPM definitions of total float and critical path
AACE International Recommended Practice No. 49R-06, Identifying the Critical Path (longest path, multiple calendars, retained logic vs progress override)
Oracle Primavera P6 help, Schedule dialog settings (retained logic / progress override, relationship lag calendar, total float), consulted for METHOD-CHECK section 7
tolerance: Section 10: objects compared over the keys given, arrays element by element with equal length, numbers |a - e| <= 1e-9 * |e|, everything else exactly.
not_benchmarked: decision_fingerprint hash value (approve: true stands for a matching fingerprint, §9)
warning restored_values and every warnings list of restore_replaces cases (§10)
null, arrays or objects in vocabulary or text fields other than the cases given (null -> "" assumed)
number text with a signed exponent (e.g. 1e+3)
order of dropping non-object rows and applying the row limits when both apply to one list
two milestone rows on the same activity absent in one scenario (milestone_not_in_both dedup)
months without any allocation between two cash months (§11.6 says they are not listed; no case)
dates beyond year 2999 produced by scheduling (only input dates are range-checked)
out_of_sequence for an SS successor started on the analysis date whose predecessor has not started (lag 0)
constraint_violated in the low/high variants (only nominal runs produce warnings, §6)
